command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_03','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','PE1','PE2','PE3','SZ_AR','SZ_Core'); `$cmds=@('show interfaces','display interface'); foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { foreach (`$c in `$cmds) { `$e=[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$e); if (`$r.output -notlike 'Error:*') { Write-Output ('===== NODE='+`$n+' COMMAND='+`$c+' ====='); (`$r.output -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object { (`$_ -match 'utility rate:\s*(?!0\.00%)\d+\.\d+%') -or (`$_ -match '(input|output) rate[: ]+([1-9][0-9]*) bits/sec') -or (`$_ -match '([1-9][0-9]*) (input errors|output errors|total output drops|drops)') } } } }"
